# prime-inputotp

prime-rs: InputOtp component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/inputotp) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-inputotp) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/inputotp.md)

InputOtp — port of the `p-inputotp` component from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A one-time code is entered one character at a time into separate `<input>` fields (classes `p-inputtext p-component p-inputotp-input`) with
auto-advance, arrow navigation, pasting of the whole code and masking.

The value is an optional two-way `value: RwSignal<String>`: the characters of the string fill the cells in order. Without `value`
the tokens live inside the component, and the result arrives via `on_change`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_inputotp::InputOtp;

let html = view! { <InputOtp length=6 value=RwSignal::new("12".to_owned()) mask=true /> }.to_html();
assert_eq!(html.matches("p-inputotp-input").count(), 6);
assert!(html.contains(r#"type="password""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-inputotp = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["inputotp"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
